data_point: Serves a single metro area or local service radius
run_when: Code found a locations page, 'areas we serve' wording or local business data.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company serves only a single metro area or a defined local service radius.
prompt.definition: This lowers the score but never disqualifies. Skip this if the company is a local professional services firm, which is already scored by its own signal.
yes_when: A 'locations' or 'areas we serve' page listing nearby towns
Text says they serve one city and its surroundings
unknown_when: Not enough information about where customers are
watch_out_for: Several office locations for a national company is not local

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

examples.input_excerpt: Proudly serving Austin, Round Rock and Cedar Park

output.evidence_quote: Proudly serving Austin, Round Rock and Cedar Park
output.reason: The company serves one metro area.
